description: Complete a ready mission and claim its CWM reward. Omit mission_id to auto-complete the first READY one. Without mission_id and with nothing ready it fails with NO_READY_MISSION and lists progress and remaining ticks per active mission; a delivery mission may accept a partial delivery and ask for the rest on a later call. Check progress with list_missions or get_status. Changes state: pays out CWM and closes the mission.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.
